pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with soft, blurred edge gradients. The patches vary in spatial area, with larger contiguous dark blocks appearing towards the upper center and more fragmented, smaller rectangular-like blocks appearing on the lower left flank area visible through foliage.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored inter-patch pathways forming a network with frequent Y-shaped and X-shaped junction nodes. The thickness of these corridors is non-uniform, showing slight widening at junction points and narrowing in linear segments. Visibility is partially obstructed by foreground vegetation at the bottom of the frame.
